idea-plugin.name: AsyncAPI Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Reliable go-to-definition for $ref in AsyncAPI documents (JSON and YAML, same-file and external-file) that never breaks across a JetBrains IDE version bump.

Built from real, current evidence: the leading FREEMIUM AsyncAPI plugin has 55% of its reviews at 3 stars or fewer (re-verified 2026-09) -- "suddenly no longer works... says the java plugin is required" (2026-02), "does not work with IntelliJ 2024.2.4" (2024-12), and a real preview bug ("Error: the asyncapi field is missing" on a file that validates fine elsewhere). This plugin does one thing -- resolve $ref reliably, locally, with no network calls, including across JSON and YAML files -- and keeps doing it release after release.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
